titulo_es: Practice accent and rhythm in frequent words

texto: Recognize Swedish letters and observe pronunciation patterns. **Betona rätt stavelse** means «Mark the right syllable». Read the expression as a unit, identify the main word and use it in a daily situation. If your device has a Swedish voice, listen to the example and repeat it. Sequence 3 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
